candidates.change_summary: Replace 'owner = _owner;' with 'owner = address(0);' so owner is set to zero address instead of the argument.
Delete the assignment 'owner = _owner;' so owner remains unchanged after setOwner call.
Replace 'owner = _owner;' with 'owner = msg.sender;' so owner is set to caller instead of the argument.
Replace 'require(msg.sender == admin, ...);' with 'require(true, ...);' effectively removing the access check, allowing anyone to change owner.
Delete the require statement, removing the onlyAdmin guard so anyone can call setOwner.
Remove the onlyAdmin modifier from setOwner, allowing arbitrary callers to change owner.
Replace 'return true' with 'return false' so that a successful setOwner call returns false instead of true.
Delete the return statement so the function implicitly returns the default bool value (false) after successful execution.
Replace `owner = _owner;` with `admin = _owner;` so that setOwner changes admin instead of owner.
Replace `owner = _owner;` with `owner = address(0);` so that setOwner always sets owner to zero address.
Replace `require(msg.sender == admin, ...)` with `require(msg.sender == owner, ...)` so onlyOwner guards setOwner.
Replace require with `require(true, ...)` so anyone can call setOwner.
Replace require with `require(false, ...)` so setOwner always reverts.
Delete the modifier `onlyAdmin` so anyone can call setOwner.
